title: Persian pronunciation and expressive TTS evaluation
summary: How can a small reproducible Persian evaluation expose pronunciation, ezafe, numeral, register and code-switching errors without confusing subjective prosody with intelligibility?
evidence_level: Real MOSS-TTS-Nano CPU output measured at signal level only; no pronunciation ratings
contribution: Ilghar Dadgostari: problem framing, requirements and evaluation direction. Implementation AI-assisted (Grok Bot), reviewed only by Grok Bot so far.
limitations: One upstream TTS run (MOSS-TTS-Nano-100M, CPU); audio not listened to, so pronunciation, intelligibility and naturalness are unmeasured.
Seeded reruns are not bit-identical (0/12); ratings must be keyed to audio sha256.
Mock tone audio (M03/M04) is not speech and is never a baseline.
Reference pronunciations and spans are unreviewed.
12 items; deterministic split gives 11 dev / 1 test, too small for a test claim.
Illustration (assets/ASSETS.json) is AI-generated, illustration only, stored on Drive not git; the native diagram is authoritative.
